items.title: Jonathan Taylor: Strong showing in Week 6 loss
items.text:
Taylor carried the ball 21 times for 94 yards and a touchdown and caught two of four targets for 57 yards in Sunday's 26-20 loss to the Titans. He also lost a fumble.

items.title: Carnell Tate: Finds end zone for first time in NFL
items.text:
Tate caught six of seven targets for 70 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-20 win over the Colts.

items.title: Tony Pollard: Leading rusher in first win of year
items.text:
Pollard carried the ball 19 times for 76 yards and failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 26-20 win over the Colts.

items.title: Cam Ward: Quiet in Week 6 win
items.text:
Ward completed 11 of 22 passes for 102 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 26-20 win over the Colts. He added seven yards on three carries.

items.title: Jaylin Noel: Records 100-plus yards, TD in Week 6
items.text:
